verdict.rationale:
Slack's official docs describe AI-generated huddle notes with key takeaways, action items, and speaker attribution recorded automatically when a huddle ends, plus broader AI recap/summary features for channels and threads that users missed. This directly matches the story for both attended and missed meetings/huddles.

missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of huddle note accuracy, and no coverage of recaps for external video-meeting recordings (e.g., Zoom) beyond huddles.
